verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Superhuman Mail as an MCP server that Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants connect to. That is the opposite role and does not show Superhuman consuming external MCP servers' tools. The agent builder mentions 'connectors' and 'the work you connect', but nothing says these are MCP servers a user can plug in, so this is an adjacent feature only. The axis applies to an AI-native email client, so the lack of MCP-client evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
